title: Attachment relationships may be incorrect
cause: Inconsistent identifiers may break attachment-to-ticket mapping
event: Migrated attachments link to the wrong ticket or lose their relationship
effect: Accepted records are not usable despite apparently complete counts
existing_control: Supplier mapping work and count reconciliation
evidence: Population-wide linkage result and justified coverage strategy are not supplied
preventive_response: Perform representative relationship checks with a justified coverage strategy and Saira review
owner: Chen with Beck; capacity and acceptance to confirm
trigger: Reproduced relationship errors, missing test inputs or no viable review window
contingency: Open a linked issue, correct the mapping and retest affected relationships before decision
note: This is not an observed failure at the 23 October cutoff.
decision_boundary: Whether current evidence supports committing to the 21 November B1 cutover

title: Restore may not produce a usable service
cause: The actual restore scenario and environment have not been demonstrated
event: Cutover failure cannot be recovered within the usable-service boundary
effect: Support lacks a usable service and business disruption continues
evidence: No applicable restore demonstration is supplied at the workshop cutoff
preventive_response: Define the restore scenario and environment, execute it and obtain the required review
owner: Technical performer to confirm; Rosa supplies service requirements
trigger: Restore fails, test inputs are unavailable or review capacity disappears
contingency: Keep hold or replan available, correct and retest before requesting go
note: Supplier obligation does not remove residual business exposure.
decision_boundary: Whether current evidence supports committing to the 21 November B1 cutover
